title: userActions.exportCsv: enforce or remove — no export menu reads the switch
body:
repo:objectstack#5 · os-bill · session_01Utp6CajiB6BSQKWowy6YLB

From fix round 3 of PR #35583 (#35401): drilling `object/userActions` in the liveness ledger measured `exportCsv` as `dead`. Seat 5 ruled to keep that verdict and to file this card.

## Defect
An author can set `userActions.exportCsv: false` on an object, and the Studio object form offers that row (`packages/spec/src/data/object.form.ts`). No export menu honours it:
- `resolveCrudAffordances` (`packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) copies it onto `CrudAffordances.exportCsv`, and nothing reads that bit;
- the server write guard, the managed `apiMethods` map and the core write clamp read only create, edit and delete;
- the ui `AFFORDANCE_GRANTS` table has no export row;
- the export menus in ObjectGrid, ListView, RelatedList and ReportExport gate on export options, `operations.export`, `allowExport` and the effective export operation.

So `exportCsv: false` does not hide export. Since #35583, `userActions.exportCsv` is graded `dead` in `packages/spec/liveness/object.json` (the full trace is in that row's note), and an authored `exportCsv` warns at `os lint` / `os validate` (`liveness-dead-property`).

## Done when
One of the two ADR-0049 routes is taken, and the ledger row moves with it:
- **Enforce:** the export surfaces read the resolved `exportCsv` bit (with a pin that `exportCsv: false` hides export on a grid and a list view, plus a CONTROL that the default still shows it), and the row is graded `live`, citing the reader; or
- **Remove:** the key is retired through the spec-property-retirement playbook (form row, docs, liveness tombstone, pins).

## Grade
p2 · area:data · domain:spec. A declared author setting has no effect; nothing is exposed that the author could not already export, and authors are now warned.
